Crucially, despite having the capability to use the WebSurfer tool and instructions to 'gather information systematically,' the agent skipped external verification of the historical consensus and the specific wording of the options, leading to a factually unsupported conclusion that violated the task's requirement for systematic data gathering.

It incorrectly conflated improved visibility with speed control (Option B) instead of safety in bad weather (Option D), and terminated the task without using the available WebSurfer tool to confirm the specific wording or consensus on the primary benefit.
